historicalFailureEvidenceOnly.role: regression mapping only; never architecture or implementation authority

canonicalization.serialization: RFC 8785 JSON Canonicalization Scheme semantics over this parsed JSON document
canonicalization.collisionOrder: globally unique ascending integer priority 1..30; lower number wins
canonicalization.profileLink: registryId+registryVersion+SHA-256 must equal the sole Owner-selected registry tuple in the corrected Design; absent, multiple or mismatched selections fail closed

astSchema.characterClassGrammar: optional leading ^, then only literal ASCII characters, ASCII ranges x-y, \\s, \\d or \\p{N}; dangling escapes, reverse/overlapping ranges and all other property/class forms fail closed
astSchema.repetitionGrammar: integer min >= 0; max is null or integer >= min; repetitions preserve historical unbounded maxima only where max is null
astSchema.referenceGrammar: references resolve only to the exact definitions map; missing, recursive or unused definitions fail closed
astSchema.boundaryGrammar: wordBoundary and startAnchor are zero-width; lookbehind/lookahead operands must be one unicodeProperty, shorthand or charClass atom

insertionTransform.admittedAtom: one Unicode 17.0 code point in the admitted insertion set after invalid-control precedence
insertionTransform.pathSemantics: expand literals to Unicode code-point atoms; alternation selects one branch; sequence concatenates; repetition contributes atom adjacencies inside and between iterations; groups are transparent; zero-width assertions never consume or create a gap
insertionTransform.directForm: compile the same AST without admitted insertion transitions
insertionTransform.insertionAwareForm: compile the same AST language IR with the declared gap transition on exactly the eligible consuming-atom adjacencies
insertionTransform.overflowSemantics: a complete skeleton with a run >4, total >64, forbidden-position insertion, unsupported node/reference or profile mismatch returns unsupported_value; unrelated nonmatching text remains allow
insertionTransform.compilerContract: validate and inline the closed AST once; lower it to one canonical transition IR; instantiate direct mode with zero inserted transitions and insertion-aware mode with the declared bounded transitions; structuredRecognizerId is metadata on the same rule, never a matcher table
insertionTransform.overflowRecognizer: the same transition IR also records complete skeleton matches whose per-gap or total insertion counters exceed policy; those return unsupported_value rather than allow

deepSeekDecision.securitySemantics: plain DeepSeek and deepseek-v4-flash values are not Provider/model literal matches unless another generic key/phrase/structured rule independently rejects the surrounding input
deepSeekDecision.rationale: material security-language exception to accepted Design V1.4 and ADR-0018; failed V3 behavior is not authority

providerModelRegistrationClosure.rule: before any future Provider/model adapter or configuration can be approved, every normalized provider token and model-family prefix in that approved registry must be covered by the selected grammar with category provider_override; otherwise configuration resolution and the architecture gate fail closed
